Question: A list of \(9\) real numbers consists of \(1,\) \(2.2,\) \(3.2,\) \(5.2,\) \(6.2,\) and \(7,\) as well as \(x,\) \(y,\) \(z\) with \(x \le y \le z.\) The range of the list is \(7,\) and the mean and median are both positive integers. How many ordered triples \((x, y, z)\) are possible?
